Input: `OUTPUT/rds/PanCK_seurat.rds` (04)
Output: Supp. Fig. 4 (FigureS4, S4a-S4e) in `OUTPUT/FIGURES/Supplementary/FigureS4` and `OUTPUT/Excel Files/Supplementary/FigureS4`

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("Setup.R")
library(clustree)
```

```{r}
PanCK_seurat <- readRDS(file.path(path_rds, "PanCK_seurat.rds"))

# Drop the cluster labels inherited from the all-AOI clustering in 04 (RNA_snn_res.0.8),
# so that the cluster tree only shows clusterings of the PanCK+ AOIs
PanCK_seurat@meta.data <- dplyr::select(PanCK_seurat@meta.data, -starts_with("RNA_snn_res."), -any_of("seurat_clusters"))

# Louvain clustering (Seurat default) at resolutions 0.6, 1.0, 1.4 and 1.8
for (r in seq(0.6, 2.0, by = 0.4)) {
  PanCK_seurat <- FindClusters(PanCK_seurat, resolution = r, verbose = FALSE)
}
```

##### Supplementary Figure 4a-c: cluster tree and overlay on the PCA
```{r}
clust <- clustree(PanCK_seurat, layout = "sugiyama", prefix = "RNA_snn_res.", use_core_edges = FALSE) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "PuRd") +
  scale_edge_color_continuous(low = "peachpuff", high = "#b2182b") +
  theme_void()

pca_data <- Embeddings(PanCK_seurat, "pca") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(PC_1, PC_2) %>%
  rename(PC1 = PC_1, PC2 = PC_2)

overlay_list <- clustree_overlay(cbind(pca_data, dplyr::select(PanCK_seurat@meta.data, Category, starts_with("RNA_snn_res."))),
                                 prefix = "RNA_snn_res.", x_value = "PC1", y_value = "PC2", plot_sides = TRUE)
side <- (overlay_list$x_side + scale_color_brewer(palette = "Reds")) +
  (overlay_list$y_side + scale_color_brewer(palette = "Reds"))

# Resolutions giving K = 3 (res 1) and K = 5 (res 1.4) clusters
overlay <- clustree_overlay(cbind(pca_data, dplyr::select(PanCK_seurat@meta.data, RNA_snn_res.1, RNA_snn_res.1.4)),
                            prefix = "RNA_snn_res.", use_colour = "points", x_value = "PC1", y_value = "PC2") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme_classic()
```

##### Supplementary Figure 4d-e: agreement of K = 3 and K = 5 clusters with Category
```{r}
meta <- PanCK_seurat@meta.data
meta$K3 <- meta$RNA_snn_res.1
meta$K5 <- meta$RNA_snn_res.1.4

alluvial_df <- meta %>%
  dplyr::select(K3, Category, K5) %>%
  group_by(K3, Category, K5) %>%
  summarise(Freq = n(), .groups = "drop")

alluvial <- ggplot(alluvial_df, aes(axis1 = K3, axis2 = Category, axis3 = K5, y = Freq)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Category), width = 1/12, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Category, name = "Category") +
  new_scale("fill") +
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)), width = 1/12, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Cluster, guide = "none") +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 3) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("K3", "Category", "K5"), expand = c(.1, .1)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
# Shannon entropy of Category within each cluster, normalised by its maximum
cluster_entropy <- function(k) {
  meta %>%
    mutate(K = as.factor(.data[[k]]), Category = as.factor(Category)) %>%
    group_by(K, Category) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(K) %>%
    summarise(cluster_size = sum(n),
              entropy = entropy::entropy(n, unit = "log2"),
              max_entropy = log2(n_distinct(Category)),
              norm_entropy = entropy / max_entropy) %>%
    mutate(norm_entropy = ifelse(is.nan(norm_entropy), 0, norm_entropy))
}

# Cluster x Category counts (tiles) under the per-cluster entropy (bars)
entropy_panel <- function(k, y_title, show_categories) {
  ent <- cluster_entropy(k)
  cat("Aggregate normalised entropy for", k, ":", sum(ent$cluster_size / sum(ent$cluster_size) * ent$norm_entropy), "\n")

  confmat <- meta %>%
    mutate(K = .data[[k]]) %>%
    group_by(K, Category) %>%
    summarise(Freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    complete(K, Category, fill = list(Freq = 0))

  tile <- ggplot(confmat, aes(x = K, y = Category, fill = Category, alpha = Freq)) +
    geom_tile(color = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Freq), color = "black", size = 4) +
    scale_alpha(range = c(0.2, 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = Category) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
  if (!show_categories) tile <- tile + scale_y_discrete(labels = NULL)

  bar <- ggplot(ent, aes(x = K, y = norm_entropy)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = K), color = "black", width = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = Cluster) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(y = y_title) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none")

  plot_grid(bar, tile, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(2, 3), align = "hv")
}

confusion <- plot_grid(entropy_panel("K3", "H(x)", TRUE), entropy_panel("K5", "", FALSE),
                       ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(4, 5))
```

```{r, fig.width = 20, fig.height = 16}
upper <- plot_grid(clust, side, ncol = 2, labels = c("a", "b"), label_size = letter_size(15), rel_widths = c(0.3, 0.6))
lower <- plot_grid(overlay, plot_grid(alluvial, confusion, ncol = 1, labels = c("d", "e"), label_size = letter_size(15)),
                   ncol = 2, labels = c("c", ""), label_size = letter_size(15))
FigureS4 <- plot_grid(upper, lower, ncol = 1)
FigureS4

save_plot(FigureS4, "FigureS4.svg", width = 15, height = 12)   # 15 in wide: prints at 50% on the page

# Single panels
save_plot(clust, "FigureS4a.svg", width = 6, height = 8)
save_plot(side, "FigureS4b.svg", width = 14, height = 8)
save_plot(overlay, "FigureS4c.svg", width = 10, height = 8)
save_plot(alluvial, "FigureS4d.svg", width = 10, height = 4)
save_plot(confusion, "FigureS4e.svg", width = 10, height = 4)

# Source data: cluster of each AOI at each resolution (a-c), cluster-tree nodes (a),
# alluvial counts (d), entropy and cluster x Category counts (e)
res_cols <- grep("^RNA_snn_res\\.", names(meta), value = TRUE)
assignments <- cbind(AOI = rownames(pca_data), pca_data, meta[rownames(pca_data), c("Category", res_cols)])
tree_nodes <- as.data.frame(clust$data) %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("."), -any_of(c("x", "y", "circular"))) %>%
  Filter(Negate(is.list), .)
cluster_counts <- function(k) {
  meta %>% dplyr::count(Cluster = .data[[k]], Category, name = "AOIs") %>% complete(Cluster, Category, fill = list(AOIs = 0))
}
save_source_data(list(Clusters = assignments, Nodes = tree_nodes), "FigureS4a")
save_source_data(assignments, "FigureS4b")
save_source_data(assignments[, c("AOI", "PC1", "PC2", "Category", "RNA_snn_res.1", "RNA_snn_res.1.4")], "FigureS4c")
save_source_data(alluvial_df, "FigureS4d")
save_source_data(list(Entropy_K3 = cluster_entropy("K3"), Entropy_K5 = cluster_entropy("K5"),
                      Counts_K3 = cluster_counts("K3"), Counts_K5 = cluster_counts("K5")),
                 "FigureS4e")
```
